columns.name: BeginString
columns.description: Identifies beginning of new message and session protocol version by means of a session profile identifier (see FIX Session Layer for details). ALWAYS FIRST FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted).

columns.name: BodyLength
columns.description: Message length, in bytes, forward to the CheckSum field. ALWAYS SECOND FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted)

columns.name: MsgType
columns.description: Defines message type ALWAYS THIRD FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted)

columns.name: SenderCompID
columns.description: Assigned value used to identify firm sending message.

columns.name: TargetCompID
columns.description: Assigned value used to identify receiving firm.

columns.name: OnBehalfOfCompID
columns.description: Assigned value used to identify firm originating message if the message was delivered by a third party i.e. the third party firm identifier would be delivered in the SenderCompID field and the firm originating the message in this field.

columns.name: DeliverToCompID
columns.description: Assigned value used to identify the firm targeted to receive the message if the message is delivered by a third party i.e. the third party firm identifier would be delivered in the TargetCompID (56) field and the ultimate receiver firm ID in this field.

columns.name: SecureDataLen
columns.description: Length of encrypted message

columns.name: SecureData
columns.description: Actual encrypted data stream

columns.name: MsgSeqNum
columns.description: Integer message sequence number.

columns.name: SenderSubID
columns.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (desk, trader, etc.)

columns.name: SenderLocationID
columns.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader)

columns.name: TargetSubID
columns.description: Assigned value used to identify specific individual or unit intended to receive message. "ADMIN" reserved for administrative messages not intended for a specific user.

columns.name: TargetLocationID
columns.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message destination's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader)

columns.name: OnBehalfOfSubID
columns.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (i.e. trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

columns.name: OnBehalfOfLocationID
columns.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

columns.name: DeliverToSubID
columns.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message recipient (i.e. trader) if the message is delivered by a third party

columns.name: DeliverToLocationID
columns.description: Assigned value used to identify specific message recipient's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

columns.name: PossDupFlag
columns.description: Indicates possible retransmission of message with this sequence number

columns.name: PossResend
columns.description: Indicates that message may contain information that has been sent under another sequence number.

columns.name: SendingTime
columns.description: Time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

columns.name: OrigSendingTime
columns.description: Original time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT") when transmitting orders as the result of a resend request.

columns.name: XmlDataLen
columns.description: Length of the XmlData data block.

columns.name: XmlData
columns.description: Actual XML data stream (e.g. FIXML). See appropriate XML reference (e.g. FIXML). Note: may contain embedded SOH characters.

columns.name: Account
columns.description: Account mnemonic as agreed between buy and sell sides, e.g. broker and institution or investor/intermediary and fund manager.

columns.name: ClOrdID
columns.description: Unique identifier for Order as assigned by the buy-side (institution, broker, intermediary etc.) (identified by SenderCompID(49) or OnBehalfOfCompID(115) as appropriate). Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day. Firms, particularly those which electronically submit multi-day orders, trade globally or throughout market close periods, should ensure uniqueness across days, for example by embedding a date within the ClOrdID(11) field.

columns.name: OrigClOrdID
columns.description: ClOrdID (11) of the previous order (NOT the initial order of the day) as assigned by the institution, used to identify the previous order in cancel and cancel/replace requests.

columns.name: SecondaryClOrdID
columns.description: Assigned by the party which originates the order. Can be used to provide the ClOrdID (11) used by an exchange or executing system.

columns.name: OrderID
columns.description: Unique identifier for Order as assigned by sell-side (broker, exchange, ECN). Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day. Firms which accept multi-day orders should consider embedding a date within the OrderID field to assure uniqueness across days.

columns.name: SecondaryOrderID
columns.description: Assigned by the party which accepts the order. Can be used to provide the OrderID (37) used by an exchange or executing system.

columns.name: ExecID
columns.description: Unique identifier of execution message as assigned by sell-side (broker, exchange, ECN) (will be 0 (zero) for ExecType (150)=I (Order Status)).

columns.name: TradeID
columns.description: The unique ID assigned to the trade entity once it is received or matched by the exchange or central counterparty.

columns.name: QuoteReqID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a QuoteRequest(35=R).

columns.name: QuoteID
columns.description: Unique identifier for quote

columns.name: QuoteRespID
columns.description: Message reference for Quote Response

columns.name: Symbol
columns.description: Ticker symbol. Common, "human understood" representation of the security. SecurityID (48) value can be specified if no symbol exists (e.g. non-exchange traded Collective Investment Vehicles)

columns.name: SecurityID
columns.description: Security identifier value of SecurityIDSource (22) type (e.g. CUSIP, SEDOL, ISIN, etc). Requires SecurityIDSource.

columns.name: SecurityIDSource
columns.description: Identifies class or source of the SecurityID(48) value.

columns.name: SecurityType
columns.description: Indicates type of security. Security type enumerations are grouped by Product(460) field value. NOTE: Additional values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

columns.name: SecuritySubType
columns.description: Sub-type qualification/identification of the SecurityType. As an example for SecurityType(167)="REPO", the SecuritySubType="General Collateral" can be used to further specify the type of REPO.

columns.name: SecurityExchange
columns.description: Market used to help identify a security.

columns.name: CFICode
columns.description: Indicates the type of security using ISO 10962 standard, Classification of Financial Instruments (CFI code) values. ISO 10962 is maintained by ANNA (Association of National Numbering Agencies) acting as Registration Authority. See "Appendix 6-B FIX Fields Based Upon Other Standards". See also the Product (460) and SecurityType (167) fields. It is recommended that CFICode be used instead of SecurityType (167) for non-Fixed Income instruments.

columns.name: MaturityDate
columns.description: Date of maturity.

columns.name: Product
columns.description: Indicates the type of product the security is associated with. See also the CFICode (461) and SecurityType (167) fields.

columns.name: Side
columns.description: Side of order (see Volume : "Glossary" for value definitions)

columns.name: OrdType
columns.description: Order type.

columns.name: Price
columns.description: Price per unit of quantity (e.g. per share)

columns.name: OrderQty
columns.description: Quantity ordered. This represents the number of shares for equities or par, face or nominal value for FI instruments.

columns.name: Quantity
columns.description: Overall/total quantity (e.g. number of shares)

columns.name: QtyType
columns.description: Type of quantity specified in quantity field. ContractMultiplier (tag 231) is required when QtyType = 1 (Contracts). UnitOfMeasure (tag 996) and TimeUnit (tag 997) are required when QtyType = 2 (Units of Measure per Time Unit).

columns.name: Currency
columns.description: Identifies currency used for price or quantity fields, depending on the asset class being traded. CurrencyCodeSource(2897) may be used to disambiguate the code source scheme used, and ISO 4217 is the default scheme if absent.

columns.name: SettlCurrency
columns.description: Currency code of settlement denomination.

columns.name: BidPx
columns.description: Bid price/rate

columns.name: OfferPx
columns.description: Offer price/rate

columns.name: BidSize
columns.description: Quantity of bid

columns.name: OfferSize
columns.description: Quantity of offer

columns.name: LastPx
columns.description: Price of this (last) fill.

columns.name: LastQty
columns.description: Quantity (e.g. shares) bought/sold on this (last) fill.

columns.name: AvgPx
columns.description: Calculated average price of all fills on this order.

columns.name: CumQty
columns.description: Total quantity (e.g. number of shares) filled.

columns.name: LeavesQty
columns.description: Quantity open for further execution. If the OrdStatus (39) is Canceled, DoneForTheDay, Expired, Calculated, or Rejected (in which case the order is no longer active) then LeavesQty could be 0, otherwise LeavesQty = OrderQty (38) - CumQty (14).

columns.name: TransactTime
columns.description: Timestamp when the business transaction represented by the message occurred.

columns.name: SettlDate
columns.description: Specific date of trade settlement (SettlementDate) in YYYYMMDD format.

columns.name: TradeDate
columns.description: Indicates date of trading day. Absence of this field indicates current day (expressed in local time at place of trade).

columns.name: ExpireTime
columns.description: Time/Date of order expiration (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

columns.name: OrdStatus
columns.description: Identifies current status of order. *** SOME VALUES HAVE BEEN REPLACED - See "Replaced Features and Supported Approach" *** (see Volume : "Glossary" for value definitions)

columns.name: ExecType
columns.description: Describes the specific ExecutionRpt (e.g. Pending Cancel) while OrdStatus(39) will always identify the current order status (e.g. Partially Filled).

columns.name: QuoteStatus
columns.description: Identifies the status of the quote acknowledgement.

columns.name: QuoteResponseLevel
columns.description: Level of Response requested from receiver of quote messages. A default value should be bilaterally agreed.

columns.name: QuoteEntryRejectReason
columns.description: Reason Quote Entry was rejected:

columns.name: OrdRejReason
columns.description: Code to identify reason for order rejection. Note: Values 3, 4, and 5 will be used when rejecting an order due to pre-allocation information errors.

columns.name: CxlRejReason
columns.description: Code to identify reason for rejection of cancellation or modification.

columns.name: Text
columns.description: Free format text string

columns.name: NoPartyIDs
columns.description: Number of PartyID (448), PartyIDSource (447), and PartyRole (452) entries

columns.name: NoSecurityAltID
columns.description: Number of SecurityAltID (455) entries.

columns.name: NoTrdRegTimestamps
columns.description: Number of timestamp entries.

columns.name: SignatureLength
columns.description: Number of bytes in signature field

columns.name: Signature
columns.description: Electronic signature

columns.name: CheckSum
columns.description: Three byte, simple checksum (see Volume 2: "Checksum Calculation" for description). ALWAYS LAST FIELD IN MESSAGE; i.e. serves, with the trailing <SOH>, as the end-of-message delimiter. Always defined as three characters. (Always unencrypted)

columns.name: msghash
columns.description: The xxh128 digest of what the message said, over the arrival record with the envelope tags left out.

columns.name: version
columns.description: The FIX version the message was read at, which is not always the one its BeginString claims.

columns.name: symbolticker
columns.description: One instrument symbol that is the same across venues, qualified by its scheme and its exchange where the message states them.

columns.name: timestamp
columns.description: The market timestamp a capture is ordered by: the first clock the message answers, in decreasing exactness.

columns.name: unixpartition
columns.description: The partition the market timestamp falls in, as whole seconds since the epoch floored to the partition width.

columns.name: parentclordid
columns.description: The client order identifier this order descends from, which no standard tag names.

columns.name: parentorderid
columns.description: The venue order identifier this order descends from, which no standard tag names.

columns.name: MsgDirection
columns.description: Specifies the direction of the message.

columns.name: entries
columns.description: Every pair the message carried, in arrival order and untranslated.

columns.name: unmapped
columns.description: The pairs no dictionary explained, a view over the arrival record.
